topic: Measuring the 'Impact' of AI in Analytics: Beyond Efficiency Gains to Decision Quality
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create one polished square editorial infographic for a LinkedIn post about measuring the business impact of AI in analytics. Final opaque PNG, generous margins, excellent readability on a phone. A contemporary professional visual, with warm ivory background, deep forest-green ink, muted terracotta and warm gold accents, refined flat graphic shapes, crisp sophisticated pictograms. NO photographs, no people in a room, no robots, no brains, no circuit patterns, no fake dashboard, no mockup.

Title at top, large and fully visible: "Measure what AI changes"

Make the central 65% of the image a substantial connected visual diagram with three distinct large pictogram scenes moving left to right. The imagery must explain the ideas, not be small decorations around text. Use generous spacing and clear short directional connectors. This is a conceptual measurement guide, NOT a chart of achieved results.
1. An oversized stopwatch visibly integrated with a report/document and a small gear. Label above or below: "Work". Short label: "Time saved".
2. A bold branching decision path with one route checked and a magnifying glass inspecting evidence. Label: "Decisions". Short label: "Quality of choices".
3. An oversized paired scene of coins beside a receipt plus a customer silhouette enclosed by a return loop. Label: "Results". Two brief labels: "Revenue" and "Customer retention". The loop indicates retention, not guaranteed growth.

Along the bottom, one slim horizontal measurement ruler with tick marks and no numbers, supporting the three stages. Footer in medium readable type: "Connect the work to the outcome."
Text must be exactly these labels. No other prose, percentages, numerical claims, tiny notes, corporate logos, signature or watermark. Avoid text-only cards, paragraphs in boxes, repetitive numbered lists, dark background and decorative icon corners. Integrate the icons into one coherent diagram with a premium editorial layout. Keep every line of text well within the canvas.
review_notes: Inspected the generated image: full title and all labels are spelled correctly and readable at phone size. Large stopwatch/report, branching choice/evidence magnifier, and revenue/customer-retention symbols explain the three measurement areas. Left-to-right connectors match the conceptual relationship described in the draft. No percentages, achieved results, invented statistics, screenshots or stock people. Opaque light background, generous spacing and no cropped elements. The composition differs from the recently published vertical Job-Agent steps, M&E classification table and data-cleaning photograph. First generation attempt passed.
alt_text: Measure what AI changes: a stopwatch and report represent time saved; a branching path and magnifier represent decision quality; coins and a customer return loop represent revenue and retention. Arrows connect work, decisions and results.
